Kept feature screens in a shared lazy placeholders module so the initial shell stays free of route content.
interfaces: AppShell accepts children plus optional storageStatus for future storage state.
AppRoutes is exported both named and default for MemoryRouter tests.
ErrorBoundary accepts resetKey to clear its error state when the route changes.

payload.taskDescription: Replace the placeholder App with HashRouter and a lazy route table for /, /case/:caseId, /case/:caseId/capture, /case/:caseId/recall, /settings, and *. Export AppRoutes so tests can use MemoryRouter. Add AppShell with a compact top bar, content region, storage/offline status slot, an ErrorBoundary that logs no user content and offers Reload and Back to shelf, an OfflineNotice bound to online/offline events, and a recoverable not-found screen. Until later features land, the four screens render clearly labeled placeholders from src/app/placeholders.tsx. Do not implement data loading or feature UI.
